accessibility.wheelchair_route: Ramp access from Gate 1, elevator to all levels via North Elevator Bank
accessibility.accessible_seating: Sections N1 and N2, rows 1-3 (field level), dedicated companion seats available
accessibility.accessible_restrooms: Located near Section N1, ground level — fully ADA-compliant
accessibility.service_animal_relief: Pet relief area located 50m outside Gate 1

accessibility.wheelchair_route: Level access from Gate 4, dedicated wheelchair lane marked with blue signage
accessibility.accessible_seating: Sections S3 and S4, elevated platform with clear sightlines
accessibility.accessible_restrooms: Located between Sections S2 and S3, ground level
accessibility.service_animal_relief: Pet relief area 80m south of Gate 3

accessibility.wheelchair_route: Flat entry from Gate 5, wide corridors throughout, tactile paving installed
accessibility.accessible_seating: Section E1, front row with removable armrests
accessibility.accessible_restrooms: Adjacent to info desk, ground level
accessibility.service_animal_relief: Indoor relief station near info desk

accessibility.wheelchair_route: Elevator access from Gate 6 to all levels, staff-assisted if needed
accessibility.accessible_seating: Section W2, mid-level with elevator access

accessibility.wheelchair_route: Private elevator from VIP Gate, dedicated wheelchair-accessible suites
accessibility.accessible_seating: All VIP suites are wheelchair accessible with adjustable viewing platforms
accessibility.accessible_restrooms: Private accessible restrooms in each suite corridor
accessibility.service_animal_relief: Private indoor relief station in VIP corridor

gates.name: Food Court Access
gates.location: Internal — accessible from all zones via main concourse

accessibility.wheelchair_route: Flat access from main concourse, lowered counters at all vendors, wide aisles
accessibility.accessible_seating: Accessible tables with wheelchair space throughout, priority seating near entrances
accessibility.service_animal_relief: Water bowls available at info point

gates.name: Medical Access
gates.location: Ground level, between North Stand and East Wing

accessibility.wheelchair_route: Direct ground-level access, automatic doors, stretcher-width corridors
accessibility.accessible_seating: Waiting area with wheelchair spaces and adjustable-height examination beds
accessibility.service_animal_relief: Indoor relief area within medical center

accessibility.wheelchair_route: Wide stroller/wheelchair-friendly paths from Gate 7, no steps anywhere in zone
accessibility.accessible_seating: Family pods with wheelchair space, shaded area available
accessibility.accessible_restrooms: Family-accessible restrooms with changing tables at both sections
accessibility.service_animal_relief: Dedicated family-friendly relief area inside zone

general_info.wifi: Free WiFi available stadium-wide. Network: FIFA2026-FanNet. No password required.
general_info.parking: Lots A-F available. Accessible parking in Lots A and B, closest to Gates 1 and 5.
general_info.public_transport: NJ Transit rail to MetLife Stadium station. Shuttle buses from NYC Penn Station every 10 minutes on match days.
general_info.lost_and_found: West Wing, near Gate 6. Open throughout event and 2 hours post-match.
general_info.prayer_rooms: Located in West Wing, non-denominational, open to all fans.
general_info.smoking_areas: Designated areas outside Gates 2, 4, and 6 only.
general_info.emergency_exits: Clearly marked with illuminated signs at every section. Staff available to guide evacuation.
